notes:
REF-BM-02: Automatically captures title, description, and preview image, but not a favicon.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable after saving, but collected metadata cannot be reviewed or edited before save.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, and tags are editable; URL and note are not.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but use a site initial instead of a favicon.
REF-BM-08: Selecting a bookmark opens an internal saved-copy reader rather than navigating to the original URL.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, host, and site name, but not notes or the complete URL.
REF-BM-14: The #tag search syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and literal-operator quoting are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as text containing quote characters rather than exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the full current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and Markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: A local frozen HTML copy with embedded images is preserved, but PDF targets are rejected rather than stored as PDFs.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-29: Saved views preserve a query and one included tag, but do not support multiple included tags or excluded tags.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
